title: Live, ten minutes old
fullTitle: Your Dashboard Says 'Live.' Its Data Is Ten Minutes Old.

scenes.narration: This panel says Live, updated zero seconds ago. The measurement behind it was observed ten minutes ago. Both are true. The first is hiding the second.
captions: The panel says Live, updated 0 s ago.
The measurement was observed ten minutes ago. Both are true.

scenes.narration: Four timelines. A source observes a value. A collector samples it every ten minutes. An API serves what the collector last stored. A browser polls every thirty seconds. Each stage stamps its own time.
captions: Source, collector, API, browser: four timelines.
Collector samples every 10 min. Browser polls every 30 s.

scenes.narration: Watch the browser poll. Two hundred OK, nineteen times before the collector samples again, every response carrying the same reading collected at time zero.
captions: 19 polls, 19 × 200 OK, before the collector samples again.
Every response carries the same reading, collectedAt 00:00:00.

scenes.narration: The response is fresh: served just now. The measurement is not: observed at zero. Two different freshness numbers, and Live reports only the first.
captions: Measurement freshness: observed at 00:00:00. Live reports only the first.

scenes.narration: So replace Live with two facts. Measurement age, from source observed at, never reset by an arriving response. And connection status, from the last poll. Connected and stale can both be true.
captions: Fix: measurement age from sourceObservedAt; connection from the last poll.
Connected and stale can both be true.

scenes.narration: Advance the shared clock without touching the source. Value stays twenty one point two. Polls keep succeeding. Nothing resets the age.
captions: Advance the shared clock. The source value does not change.
Polls succeed. Nothing resets the age.

scenes.narration: Thirty seconds. Sixty. Three hundred and thirty, past this fixture's five-minute stale policy, still two hundred OK. Five minutes is this dashboard's choice; a daily report might accept hours.
captions: 30 s, 60 s … 330 s: past this fixture's 300 s stale policy, still 200 OK.
Five minutes is this dashboard's policy, not a universal rule.

scenes.narration: Break the collector. The API still answers two hundred with the old reading; age reaches twelve hundred seconds while the connection stays green. Break the API: five oh three. The last value stays, with a warning. Nothing is invented.
captions: Collector down: API still 200, age 1200 s, connection green.
API down: 503. Last value kept with an explicit warning. Nothing invented.

scenes.narration: Freshly fetched does not mean freshly observed. Polling faster, or a WebSocket, delivers the same old reading sooner. Future timestamps are flagged, never shown negative.
captions: Freshly fetched does not mean freshly observed.
Polling faster or a WebSocket delivers the same old reading sooner.
